title: PlanningIntent
description: Resolution-independent, backend-neutral description of a single UI screen derived by an MCP client's LLM from a planning material (mockup image / slide). The boundary contract between client interpretation and Unity-side generation. Coordinates are normalized 0..1 relative to referenceCanvas.

version.description: PlanningIntent schema version. Fixed; server rejects mismatched majors.

screenName.description: Human-readable name for the screen. Used for the generated Canvas/panel GameObject name.

referenceCanvas.description: The reference resolution the normalized coordinates were authored against. UguiBackend scales normalized 0..1 by this to produce px.

elements.description: Flat list of UI elements. Tree structure is expressed via parentClientHintId references within this same intent (forward-references allowed; resolved by an in-call hint->canonical map).

clientHintId.description: ADVISORY client-assigned id. Authoritative ONLY for intra-call parent linkage within this intent. The server mints the canonical elementId and returns the {clientHintId, elementId} pair. Do not reuse hints for later edits.

parentClientHintId.description: clientHintId of the parent element within this same intent. Omit for a root-level element parented to the screen Canvas.

type.description: UI element kind. v1 uGUI-mappable set.

anchor.description: RectTransform anchor preset. Determines how rect is interpreted relative to the parent.

props.description: Element-type-specific properties (e.g. text content, color, sprite hint). Backend-interpreted; unknown keys ignored.

normRect.description: Normalized rectangle. x,y = element top-left position as a 0..1 fraction of referenceCanvas; w,h = size as a 0..1 fraction. Origin top-left.
